original_value: A fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for color-focused creative work, featuring a 2560 x 1440 OLED panel, 240 Hz refresh rate, and adaptive sync support. It emphasizes wide-gamut image rendering, factory calibration, and a slim stand intended for studio desks rather than storage or enterprise use.
